correctness.rationale: Finite tree fixed loci are convex and nonempty. Each invariant two-element set induces a locally constant C2 character; trivial sector equals configurations on X^H. A nontrivial character gives a free involution on X^(ker chi) minus X^H. Every complementary convex subtree component is paired with a distinct component, since a self-preserved component would contain the fixed midpoint of a point and its image. Each quotient component is contractible. Farley–Sabalka two-particle critical-cell theorem provides the graph wedge and exact loop rank. A standalone finite independent enumeration checked 194 actions and 2,014 invariant sample pairs.
